description: Did the ninepence once, and offered to set the letter by his cloak without opening it.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Took threepence, kept ninepence unpaid from becoming ninepence spent, and left her old ruling on the comedy where it was.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Reported the octavo as news, left the paper unpaid, and refused to rewrite the letter.
name: William Shakespeare
